price_note: Prices tax-included (the page prints ※メニューは全て税込み価格です), straight from the shop's own menu page. This is the brand-wide card shared by the Shinjuku and Kichijoji branches — the shop publishes one menu rather than per-branch prices, so treat it as the Shinjuku card unless the counter says otherwise. Prices approximate — may change.

items.en: The house bowl and the reason the shop exists: a clear salt ramen whose broth is simmered from the bones, heads and collars — the ara — of whatever fish came in that morning, so it tastes different by season rather than by recipe
items.note: 中華麺は小麦。Wheat noodles, fish broth. Large size is free — say 大盛りで when you hand over the ticket.

items.ja: あら炊き塩らぁめん へしこ焼きおにぎり付き
items.romaji: ara-daki shio ramen, heshiko yaki-onigiri tsuki
items.en: The salt ramen with a grilled rice ball folded through with heshiko — mackerel cured for a year in rice bran. The intended move is to drop the rice ball into the leftover broth at the end and eat it as a porridge
items.note: 麺＝小麦、焼きおにぎりには醤油を塗る。Wheat noodles; the rice ball is soy-brushed before grilling. Heshiko is fermented mackerel.

items.ja: あら炊き辛塩らぁめん
items.en: The same fish-bone salt broth with chilli worked in. Heat is set at the counter: ちょい辛 mild ☆ / 中辛 medium ☆☆ / 辛塩 full ☆☆☆☆☆
items.note: 麺＝小麦。辣油・辛味噌にも小麦系調味料が入ることが多い。Wheat noodles, and chilli pastes commonly carry soy or wheat too.

items.ja: あら炊き辛塩らぁめん へしこ焼きおにぎり付き
items.romaji: ara-daki kara-shio ramen, heshiko yaki-onigiri tsuki
items.en: Chilli salt ramen with the heshiko grilled rice ball
items.note: 麺＝小麦、焼きおにぎりに醤油。Wheat noodles plus a soy-brushed rice ball.

items.en: Seasonal: chilled ramen built on asari clams (summer only)
items.section: 季節限定メニュー Seasonal
items.note: 価格は店頭表示のみ。The shop lists this without a price on its own page — read the board rather than guessing. Wheat noodles.

items.ja: 冷しはまぐりらぁめん
items.en: Seasonal: chilled ramen built on hamaguri hard clams (summer only)
items.section: 季節限定メニュー Seasonal
items.note: 価格は店頭表示のみ。No price published. Wheat noodles.

items.ja: トッピング ①海老つみれ ②鶏軟骨入りつくね ④水葉
items.romaji: topping — ebi tsumire / tori-nankotsu tsukune / mizuha
items.en: Toppings, first group: prawn ball, chicken meatball with cartilage worked through it, and greens
items.note: つみれ・つくねはつなぎに小麦粉やパン粉を使うのが一般的。Fish and chicken balls are usually bound with wheat flour or panko — ask. The greens alone are safe.

items.ja: トッピング ③白髪ねぎ ⑤岩手産三陸わかめ ⑥自家製塩味玉子
items.romaji: topping — shiraga-negi / Sanriku wakame / jikasei shio-ajitama
items.en: Toppings, second group: hair-fine shredded spring onion, Sanriku wakame seaweed from Iwate, and the house salt-cured soft-boiled egg
items.note: 味玉は「塩味」表記だが漬け地の詳細は未公表。Marinated ramen eggs are normally steeped in soy; this one is described as salt-cured (塩味玉子), which is promising but unconfirmed — ask. Negi and wakame are plant-only and wheat-free.

items.en: All six toppings at once
items.note: つみれ・つくね・味玉を含むため要確認。Includes the fish/chicken balls and the egg — ask.

items.en: Coriander, as much as they give you
items.note: 生の香草のみ。Fresh herb only.

items.en: Grilled rice ball mixed with heshiko, mackerel cured a year in rice bran. Salty, pungent and the thing to order if you only order one side
items.note: 焼きおにぎりは醤油を塗る＝小麦。へしこの漬け床にも調味料が入る。Soy-brushed before grilling; the heshiko cure carries seasonings too.

items.en: Small rice bowl topped with spicy pollock roe
items.note: 明太子の調味液には醤油・酒が入るのが一般的。The mentaiko cure normally contains soy sauce and sake — ask.

items.en: Heshiko over rice with hot tea or broth poured over — the traditional way this fish is eaten in Fukui
items.note: 出汁や茶漬けの素に醤油系調味料が入ることが多い。The pouring broth is very likely soy-seasoned — ask. Fermented fish.

items.en: Plain white rice, nothing on it
items.note: 白米のみ、味付けなし。Steamed rice with no seasoning at all — no wheat, no animal product. Worth knowing: it is the only thing on this card a coeliac can safely eat.

items.ja: ソーセージ（バジルウィンナーとチョリソー）
items.en: Two kinds of sausage on one plate, basil wiener and chorizo. Put there for the beer
items.note: ソーセージの結着材・調味料に小麦や麦芽由来のものが使われることがある。Sausage binders and seasonings often carry wheat or malt extract — ask.

items.en: Chopped raw octopus in wasabi — the default izakaya nibble
items.note: たこわさの調味には醤油や麺つゆが一般的。Usually seasoned with soy sauce or mentsuyu — ask.

items.en: Bottled beer
items.note: 麦芽＝グルテン。Barley malt.

items.en: Whisky highball
items.note: ウイスキー＝麦由来。Malt whisky base — not gluten-free.

items.en: Lemon sour
items.note: ベース焼酎の原料未記載、麦焼酎を要確認。Base shochu unspecified — rule out barley shochu.

items.en: Shochu lengthened with oolong tea
items.note: 同上、ベース焼酎の原料未記載。Same base-spirit question.

items.en: Oolong tea
items.note: 烏龍茶であり麦茶ではない。Oolong, not the barley tea (麦茶) that would carry gluten.

items.en: Cola
